description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Median Rent/wk' headline figure in the Market
section.

Latest median advertised weekly rent for the suburb, by house and unit
(AUD per week). Each value is the latest
observation we hold and carries its own date (`house_as_of`, `unit_as_of`);
`as_of` is the newer of the two. Dates are never later than today.

**Price: 12¢ per call.**
